categories.name: Teams Beaten on V.Hard
categories.description: All 27 NBA teams beaten in one record on V.Hard, each game won in regulation (no overtime), which also completes the game (the 27-0 ending).

categories.name: Player 1 Stat Feats
categories.description: Every Player 1 stat feat: a field goal, 3-pointer, dunk, assist, steal, block and rebound, then ten of each, plus going On Fire.

categories.name: Scoring Records
categories.description: A 100-point game as Player 1 and a 200-point game.

playthrough_notes: One record (one set of initials) carries the whole set. Beat all 27 teams in a row on V.Hard without losing and without any game going to overtime: that one run earns the win streaks (5, 10, 20 in a row), every V.Hard milestone and the ending. If a game is lost, the win streak restarts; a commenter reads the V.Hard achievement logic as not counting losses (ra-comments-18-1), but no source confirms what a loss or an overtime game does to the V.Hard milestones, so treat every V.Hard game as must-win in regulation. Do not make extra records: a commenter warns that more than one account stops most achievements (ra-comments-1-3), and initials starting with DA block the main achievements (ra-comments-1-1). The game does not save: keep the password after each win (ra-comments-1-5). The 100- and 200-point games come last, on Normal difficulty with the Power-Up Fire code (ra-comments-2-1, ra-comments-2-3), so a loss there cannot break the streak. No source reports achievements that lock each other out.
settings_notes: Hardcore Mode, US ROM (ra-comments-1-2). One emulator caveat from the comments: an achievement called Warning did not trigger in RetroArch (ra-comments-1-6); it is not in the current set. Options: set the computer difficulty to V.Hard for the 27-team run; Tag Mode OFF, because the assist achievement only triggers with Tag Mode off (ra-comments-21-1); a very fast clock shortens games (ra-comments-1-11). Computer assistance is an Options screen setting (gf1-18-10); turning it off is part of the 200-point plan (ra-comments-1-10). Whether Tonight's Match-up power-up codes are allowed during the V.Hard run is an open question in the comments with no answer, so the route plays the V.Hard run without codes.

missables.label: V.Hard run: every game must be won in regulation (A Good Start through Legendary Team)
missables.deadline: Every V.Hard game from team 1 to team 27: a single game that goes to overtime fails the 'without going into overtime' condition

chapters.title: Setup, Options and Controls
chapters.notes: No achievements here. Cover: US ROM; initials (never starting with DA; one record only); Options (V.Hard, Tag Mode off, fast clock); the controls (shoot, pass, turbo, steal, block, rebound, dunk vs layup); team choice (Charlotte/Chicago power forward-center pairs per ra-comments-2-4, team rankings from gf6). The game does not save: write down the password after every win.

chapters.title: V.Hard Games 1-5: First Win and the Basic Feats
chapters.notes: In the password list's run the opponents came in a fixed order (Dallas, Minnesota, Miami, Washington, Philadelphia for games 1-5). The single Player 1 feats (field goal, three, dunk, assist, steal, block, rebound, On Fire) come naturally in these first games; blocks are harder than in Jam TE (ra-comments-1-4). Win in regulation: build a lead, milk the clock at half court, then drive late in the shot clock (ra-comments-1-13, gf1-8-2). 5 wins in a row also gives A Win Streak.

chapters.title: V.Hard Games 6-10
chapters.notes: Sacramento, Denver, Milwaukee, Indiana, Atlanta (password list order). Same anti-rubber-banding plan; 10 wins in a row gives Bigger Streak.

chapters.title: V.Hard Games 11-15
chapters.notes: Clippers, Orlando, Golden State, Boston, Houston (password list order; the list writes 'Washington Clippers'). The CPU's buzzer long shots are the main way to lose late (ra-comments-1-9), and gf1-7-5 shows how to block the buzzer three.

chapters.title: V.Hard Games 16-20
chapters.notes: Charlotte, L.A. Lakers, New Jersey, Cleveland, Detroit (password list order). The list's player used Detroit and switched to Chicago for game 20 against Detroit (gf-passwords-2-2, gf-passwords-2-22): if your own team is next on the list, pick another team for that game. 20 wins in a row gives Unbeatable.

chapters.title: V.Hard Games 21-27 and the Ending
chapters.notes: San Antonio, New York, Portland, Utah, Seattle, Phoenix, Chicago (password list order). New York is the guide's top-ranked team (gf6-8-1). Beating all 27 teams (27-0) shows the SNES ending and gives NBA All-Star; the ending does not depend on difficulty (gf1-17-3). Do not use gf1's 'DAN' 26-0 password: initials starting with DA block the main achievements (ra-comments-1-1). A commenter saw Legendary Team pop early (ra-comments-2-10).

chapters.title: Score Attack and Stat Clean-Up
chapters.notes: After the V.Hard run: set Normal difficulty, slow clock (ra-comments-2-1), computer assistance off (ra-comments-1-10), and enter Power-Up Fire at Tonight's Match-up: B seven times, then hold B+Y+Up until tip-off (ra-comments-2-3, gf2-2-3). Juice mode is on after beating every team (ra-comments-1-12). 100 points as Player 1 and 200 points total. The ten-count feats (threes, dunks, assists, steals, blocks, rebounds, field goals) may already have unlocked during the run; the sources do not say whether the count is per game or cumulative, so if any is missing, keep playing games here until it pops. Assists need Tag Mode off.
